quote: Planning is safe. Execution is not.
Execution is scary because it forces you to risk being seen.
You don't act because you're confident. You become confident because you act.
The longer you delay action, the heavier it feels to move.
You only need courage for five seconds. After that, momentum takes over.
Execution is the difference between wishing and winning.
No one remembers a planner. The world respects movers, makers, and doers.
